title: Ramsays bolt a plaque to the mesa
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ramsays bolt a plaque to the mesa, about 2007 at New Mexico (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, in 2007, Suzanne and Scott fixed the record themselves by bolting a plaque to the mesa, signed and dated.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2007 a couple named Scott and Suzanne Ramsay, who researched a claimed crash of a craft with alien bodies at Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, bolted a signed and dated plaque to the mesa there. According to Michels, they did it to "fix the record" themselves, marking the spot where they believe the crash happened.
